description: rcf-lite 0.41.0 ships the stripped twelve-rule process (Baz decision 14, built from main at 892bc858e169, round G out): the npm package no longer ships its own rcf/ folder; test strength is a recorded report that refuses nothing, so the tool referees structure, never adequacy; the managed agent-instructions block, rcf guidance build-cycle, the bundle runbook and rcf guidance overview state the twelve rules of the build cycle.
rationale: Baz decisions 11, 12 and 14 (2026-11-06); bloat analysis section 7 (K15, K21); round contract rows C1, C3, C5, C6 and C7; Dave's rulings R0 E1, R1 option 1, R3, R4, R5; C4 cut (ruling 7).
title: rcf-lite 0.41.0: the package keeps its own chain private, test strength is a report, and the shipped text states the twelve rules
